name: Ninshin Kenkyuujo ~ Fukusayou wa Inranka
original_name: 妊娠研究所～副作用は淫乱化
source:
Koichi works at a pharmaceutical company. One day, he invents a new medicine. When he tells Miwa, his boss, about it, she soon says, "Give it to me!" Ten minutes after she takes it, she suddenly takes off her clothes and starts masturbating.... Side effect of his medicine...?

[From ErogeShop]
translation:
浩一在一家制药公司工作。一天，他发明了一种新药。把这件事告诉上司美和后，对方立刻说：“给我试试！”服药十分钟后，她突然脱掉衣服，开始自慰…这是药物的副作用吗…？

[From ErogeShop]
